verdict.rationale: Superpowers does ship agent-oriented docs. Codex and OpenCode installs work by telling the agent to fetch and follow a raw GitHub INSTALL.md, and the skills themselves are plain markdown SKILL.md files written for agents to read. There is no llms.txt, and the docs-md probe returned 404, so it lacks a conventional machine-readable docs index for agents. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, .md-served documentation pages, and first-party docs describing an agent-readable docs entry point.
